alt: Screenshot of the Logic Pro 13 Intelligent Assistant AI feature panel with a subscription paywall notice, displayed against the Logic Pro DAW interface
story: On November 5, 2026, Apple released Logic Pro 13.0 with an AI-powered 'Intelligent Assistant' — but the feature requires a $12.99/month Apple Creator Studio subscription and is excluded from the $199.99 one-time-purchase version, reversing Apple's earlier promise that Logic Pro features would be identical regardless of which way you paid.
why_funny: Apple spent years mocking Adobe's subscription-only model, then launched their AI feature in their flagship paid DAW locked behind — a subscription.
